pages.title: BAARAW
pages.text:
**FURUYA NI JUGUYALEN**

Jardin bɛ se ka kɛ **banaba** ye ni i ye a ye ko:

- **Juruya** bɛ a ka **yiridenw** kan (fiɲɛ, jɛ, walima **kɔgɔba**), **furuyalen** bɛ a ka **denw** walima a ka **juruw** kan,
- **Yiridenw** **juguyalen** walima **gɔngɔlɔnnen**, **ɲɛgɛnɛlen** tuma bɛɛ, hali ni **jardin** ye **ji** sɔrɔ ka ca.

**ƝƐGƐNƐLEN**
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour TÂCHES

pages.title: JI CAMAN
pages.text:
JINYE CAMAN/GELEN CAMAN/NWOLON CAMAN

Banaw be bonya ni :

- Ji caman : ji-donni ka ca, dugujukɔrɔ ka nɔgɔ tuma bɛɛ, sanji ka gɛlɛn.

- Ji riɲan : yiri min ka miɲɛn, o tɛ se ka banabaara kɛ kosɛbɛ.

- Hɛɛrɛba walima nwolonba : nɔgɔya ninnu be se ka yiri barika gɛn ka bana kɛcogo bonya.

- Hakɛ riɲan yiriw cɛ : yiriw ka surunbaara be se ka nɔgɔya bonya ani o be bana kɛcogo bonya.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour TROP D’EAU

pages.title: KƆN
pages.text:
BƆ - MAGAN - KAN
**Mun ka kan ka kɛ ni jiri dɔ tɔrɔna ye**?

- **Bɔ a yɔrɔ minnu tɔrɔna**: i ka a bla, a wisiw, walima a denninw minnu tɔrɔna ka bɔ, walasa a kana taga yɔrɔ wɛrɛ la.

- **Bɔ jiri bɛɛ lajɛnni na** ni a tɔrɔra kosɛbɛ ka se ka kisi.

- **Magan jiri la** ani dugukolo la ni **compost** walima **compost jus** dɔɔnin ye.

- **Kɛ dɔgɔya kɛcogo yɛrɛyɛrɛ dɔ la**: jaba jus, nim purin, bicarbonate…

pages.title: JIRITIGƐLA
pages.text:
JINJINNI KƐLI KAN KƐ KAN SƆRƆ

Nafolo ka ban ka segin, i bɛ se ka kɛ:

* Jiritigɛla walasa ka fɛnɲɛnɛ ni yeelen bila ka tɛmɛ, ani ka jinjinni dɔgɔya min bɛ sigi.
* Jinjinni kɛli kan kɛ kan sɔrɔ

pages.title: Wolo-finiw
pages.text:
Yiridenw kɔrɔtalenw
Denbaya gɛlɛya
Bana-juruw nɛnɛmanw
Folifoliw dafara
Ni yiri ma nafa bɛɛ sɔrɔ minnu ka kan ni a ye, o bɛ yirila.

Ni i ye ninw ye, yiri bɛ se ka kɔrɔtɔ:

- Wolo-finiw (sɔɔlɔn yiri jukɔrɔ)
- Yiridenw dɔgɔmanw walima kɔrɔtalenw
- Bana-juruw jɛmanw walima nɛnɛmanw
- Folifoliw dafara, jɛmanw walima nɛnɛmanw
- Denbaya gɛlɛya, yiriw dɔgɔmanw

pages.title: DUGUKOLO JUGU
pages.text:
DUGUKOLO MIN BƐ KAN, A KA PH (ASIDI NI BASI) MA SƆN KAN

Kɔrɔnfɛn caman bɛ labɛn tuma min na:

- Dugukolo ka jugu ani kompost bɛ faga walima a ka nɔgɔ.

- Dugukolo ka kan kosɛbɛ walima a tɛ fɛn caman sɔrɔ: ji ni fɛnɲɛnɛn tɛ se ka se jijiw ma ka nɔgɔya.

- Dugukolo ka pH (asidi walima basi) ma sɔn kan: a ka asidi kosɛbɛ walima a ka basi kosɛbɛ, o bɛ se ka fɛnɲɛnɛn dɔw bali, hali ni u bɛ dugukolo kɔnɔ.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour SOL PAUVRE

pages.title: KA FAHAMU
pages.text:
TRAITER TESTER BASIQ U IDE AC pH IDE AC BASIQ UE NEUTRE pH NEUTRE E ANALYSER

Ni dɔgɔya bɛɛ bɛ kɛ, an bɛ se ka kɛ:

- Ka **kɔmpɔs** nɔgɔn caman lajɛ tuma o tuma: buruwɛti 1-2 fɛnsɛn kan, jɛgɛ lajɛlenw kɔnɔ.
- Ka **yiriba fura** (nɛnɛ, kɔnsɔn, nimba…) lajɛ walasa ka bonya dɛmɛ.
- Ka **dugukolo pH** lajɛ ni kɔrɔbɔli tɛ ban (pH kɔgɔrɔ walima kit dɔgɔ). Ni a ka nɔgɔn kosɛbɛ, an bɛ se ka a labɛn ni **dugukolo chaux** dɔgɔya ye.

- Ka dugukolo lajɛ walasa ka fɛn dɔgɔya lajɛ.

pages.title: Ɲɛgɛnɛw minnu bɛ yɛlɛn
pages.text:
Kuluw, Lafinɛw minnu bɛ kɛɲɛ walima minnu bɛ nɔgɔn, Dibiw minnu bɛ nɔgɔn, Jɔli. Ɲɛgɛnɛw minnu bɛ dibi kɛ bɛ dibi kɛ yiriw la, u bɛ sɔgɔsɔgɔninjɛ dɔgɔya ani u bɛ bana don. A ka fisa ka u dɔn fɔlɔ walasa ka dibi dɔgɔya:

Ɲɛgɛnɛw minnu bɛ yɛlɛn: cɛnɛw, nɛgɛnɛw jɛw, pucerons, cɛnɛw, asticots… Yirifoliw la: yɔrɔw minnu bɛ dugu walima yɔrɔw minnu bɛ cɛmancɛ la Dibiw minnu bɛ bɔ, minnu bɛ nɔgɔn walima minnu bɛ dugu kɔfɛ Lafinɛw minnu bɛ kɛɲɛ walima minnu bɛ nɔgɔn: pucerons bɛ yen Jɔli dɔgɔw lafinɛw kɔnɔ walima jɔliw kɔnɔ: wɛrɛw, nématodes Kuluw bɛ yen yiriw kan walima lafinɛw kɔnɔ
pages.illustration_description: Kalan-kɛcogo nɔgɔnɛw minnu bɛ yɛlɛn na

pages.title: K'AN YƐLƐMA KAN :
pages.text:
Denmisɛnw Jiridenw minnu tɛ fanga sɔrɔ

- Choux, tomate, fɛnɛ ni gombo walima gban kɔnɔna

Jiriden dɔw ka gɛlɛn ka ban, o la, a ka kan ka yɛlɛma kan kosɛbɛ :

Denmisɛnw ni jiridenw, u ka bla ka nɔgɔn kosɛbɛ, o la, sansanw b'u fɛ kosɛbɛ. Jiridenw minnu tɛ fanga sɔrɔ walima minnu ka dɔgɔ, u tɛ se ka u yɛrɛ tanga koɲuman. Jiridenw i n'a fɔ choux, tomate, fɛnɛ walima gombo, u bɛ sɔrɔ ka kɛ fɛnɛw ye tuma caman.
pages.illustration_description: Kalan-yɔrɔ kɔlɔsili K'AN YƐLƐMA KAN :

pages.title: KƆRƆBƆLI
pages.text:
ASPERGER

Ni i ye fɛn caman ye minnu bɛ nafa bɔ i ka fɛnnu la:

- **Bɔ wolo caman minnu bɛ kɔrɔbɔli dɔgɔya**
- **Fɛn caman bɔ fɛn caman na walasa ka fɛn caman bɔ**
- **Dafa jɔli walima jɔli dɔgɔya ka kɛɲɛ ni fɛn caman ye minnu bɛ wuli**
PROTÉGER

pages.title: KƆLƆSI
pages.text:
PLANTER DES RÉPULSIFS ATTIRER LES INSECTES UTILES BASILIC MENTHE CITRONNELLE GUÊPE COCCINELLE

Walasa ka fiyɛnɲɛnɛw kana segin:

- I k'a kɔlɔsi tuma bɛɛ yiridunba kɔfɛ ani yiri kura kan. O b'a to i bɛ problemuw dɔn fɔlɔfɔlɔ.

- I ka yiriw dugu minnu bɛ fiyɛnɲɛnɛw gɛn, i n'a fɔ **basilic**, **menthe**, **citronnelle** walima **œillets d’Inde**, ka olu dugu sɛnɛkɛyɔrɔ daminɛ na.

- I ka fiyɛnɲɛnɛ nafaw ka na, i n'a fɔ **coccinelles** walima **guêpes** dɔw, minnu bɛ fiyɛnɲɛnɛw dumu. I ka fiyɛnɲɛnɛ juguw bila tasuma kan sɛnɛkɛyɔrɔ daminɛ na ni nɔgɔw ye walasa ka kɔnɔw ja. O kɔnɔw bɛna na ka fiyɛnɲɛnɛ juguw ɲini yiriw kan kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la.

pages.title: KA JANYAN/KA JANYAN
pages.text:
KA JANYAN /KA NƆGƆN

* **Jigɛli** ka kɛ koɲuman o kɛra tile kɔnɔ
* **Jigɛli** ka kɛ fɔlɔfɔlɔ walima a laban

Nin ye sababu ye min bɛ fɛnɲɛnɛ dɔgɔya:

* Dugukolo ka janyan walima ka janyan
* Jɔnya caman: ka janyan, ka nɔgɔn
* Jigɛli ka kɛ koɲuman o kɛra tile kɔnɔ
* Jigɛli ka kɛ fɔlɔfɔlɔ walima a laban
* Dugukolo ka gɛlɛn: jijiw bɛ teliya ka sigi

**DUGUKOLO GƐLƐN**

pages.title: PAILLER
pages.text:
JI KAN + SUNZAN JIRIW KA JIRIBA

K’a kalon ka teli ka faga: **jiri ka teli ka kɛnɛya** ni a ye **yɔrɔɲuman** sɔrɔ. Ni a ma kɛnɛya:

- **Paillage** don ka **dugujukɔnɔko** mara
- **Ji kan** tuma bɛɛ nka **dɔɔnin dɔɔnin**
- **Sunzan jiriw** ni **jiriba** ye

pages.title: A KA FURA
pages.text:
FURA JOLI KA KAN KA KUN, YƆRƆW KA KAN KA KUN

Bio-intensif la, cɛn ka kan ka laɲini cogo di?

- Fura joli ka kan ka kun, waati bɛɛ la
- Yɔrɔw ka kan ka kun
- Jiridenw ka kan ka ɲɔgɔn fɛ
- Jiridenw ka kan ka yɛlɛn yɛlɛn

JIRIDENW KA KAN KA YƐLƐN YƐLƐN

pages.title: K'A LABANTA
pages.text:
JINJI N'A KUNBƐN N'A KƆNƆJURU + JINJI DƆGƆYA

Faso jɛlɛn na, i ka foroba ka diɲɛ kɛɲɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni diɲɛ ye cogo di :

- I ka kɔnɔjuru / kɔnɔjuru ji di a ma tuma bɛɛ
- I ka a kunbɛn kosɛbɛ
- I ka jinji dɔgɔya ka jinji di foroba ni sigi-yɔrɔw ma
- I ka nɛgɛso-juruw (filets) kɛ ka yɛlɛw bali
- I ka ji diɲɛ labanta ni a ka bonya ye
- NƐGƐSO-JURUW
